'''Aya Endō''' (Japanese: '''遠藤綾''' ''Endō Aya'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Endō was born on February 17, 1980, in {{wp|Yamagata Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She began her work in the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|DP}}, where she voiced [[Veilstone Gym|Veilstone]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Maylene]] and [[character of the day]] [[Sally]]. However, her most prominent role was [[Alexa]] in the {{aniseries|BW|''Black & White''}} and {{aniseries|XY|''XY''}} [[series]]. She also voiced [[Sinnoh]] {{pkmn|Champion}} [[Cynthia]] for the spin-off series [[Pokémon Generations]]. Endō is currently affiliated with the talent agency Office PAC and won both Best Musical Performance and Best Supporting Actress during the {{wp|2nd Seiyu Awards}} of 2008 and the {{wp|3rd Seiyu Awards}} of 2009, respectively.
